review_comments: Just to make sure I understand what's going on here: we do not consider pointers of `Type` to be interesting, right? Or is #101211 saying that we shouldn't be doing that, but we are?

`Type*` should not be considered for dataflow analysis. All the tools correctly report IL2098 due to invalid annotations on uninteresting `Type*`.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/101211 is about the analyzer still considering `Type*` in dataflow analysis, and incorrectly reporting IL2067 about annotations on `typePtr` mismatching the requirements of `RequirePublicFields`. Basically the `IsTypeInterestingForDataflow` check isn't wired up correctly in the analyzer, so it only impacts the IL2098 warnings, not the dataflow warnings.
